items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: So I got Russ, I had Gaudet's son, Gaudet's son, Russ Lund got his son, Russ Lund got his son, his drums... we went back to St. Monica's and won the contest

ctx.x: Oh I see. He never worked with the Chinatown, Sun White.

Let me see. Sun worked there a while, but his son's mother died and he got a wife, didn't want him to play no music, he started working at the child at the hospital. So I got Russ, I had Gaudet's son, Gaudet's son, Russ Lund got his son, Russ Lund got his son, his drums, Russ, you understand? And had Gaudet's son. Well, Joe got hot because, that bunch got hot because we went back to St. Monica's and won the contest and he still got ready and he still, uh, uh, uh. stuff
Gordette's son away from me too.
